set firewall family inet6 filter NETOPS-JUNOS-FIREWALL-FILTERS-V6 term t6-src from source-address 2001:db8:2::0/48
set firewall family inet6 filter NETOPS-JUNOS-FIREWALL-FILTERS-V6 term t6-src then count c6-src
set firewall family inet6 filter NETOPS-JUNOS-FIREWALL-FILTERS-V6 term t6-src then accept
set firewall family inet6 filter NETOPS-JUNOS-FIREWALL-FILTERS-V6 term t6-deny from source-address 2001:db8:3::0/48
set firewall family inet6 filter NETOPS-JUNOS-FIREWALL-FILTERS-V6 term t6-deny then reject
set firewall family inet6 filter NETOPS-JUNOS-FIREWALL-FILTERS-V6 term t6-rest then count c6-rest
set firewall family inet6 filter NETOPS-JUNOS-FIREWALL-FILTERS-V6 term t6-rest then accept
